revision_note: Prepare v1 failed closed before package creation because six pseudobulk-complete response genes were absent from the authenticated FDR axis. Prepare v2 then passed the count and exclusion checks but failed closed because the diagnostic preregistration hash used a noncanonical separator. Prepare v3 passed the corrected 4,974-gene axis checks but failed closed because 558,367 available-pair FDR entries are nonfinite, including 38 all-missing context-target blocks. V4 freezes nonfinite FDR as unlabelled and never imputes it; no package was created and no evaluation outcome was accessed.
hypothesis: The probability that an a15-shaped downstream sign is wrong is a nonlinear function of production-donor evidence and destination basal state. Strictly context-and-target-cross-fitted prediction of that probability can identify a high-precision wrong-sign tail whose norm-preserving sign inversion improves directional credit without materially reducing complete-gallery PDS.

source_schema.effect: Control-referenced log1p profiles reconstructed at target_sum=50,000 from pseudobulk_sum_by_ko.csv before differencing.
source_schema.fdr: Authenticated fdr_matrix.csv, aligned by context, target, and response gene; fixed training threshold 0.05 with frozen 0.01/0.05/0.10 sensitivity.

response_axis.construction: Parent order intersected first with response genes complete across every permitted pseudobulk column and then with the authenticated FDR response axis, excluding all 300 VCC targets. The 81 evaluation-target coordinates remain available for signed-credit use subject to the row-own mask but are excluded from the historical-panel whitener.

metric_masks.pds: Exclude the union of all 81 permitted DepMap evaluation-target coordinates and all 300 VCC target-gene coordinates.
metric_masks.signed_credit_label_and_evaluation: Exclude all 300 VCC target-gene coordinates and only the current row's own permitted DepMap perturbation target coordinate.
metric_masks.intervention: Use the signed-credit row mask: all 300 VCC coordinates plus only the current row's own target are ineligible.

baseline.name: selected_slice_a15_core_source_baseline
baseline.implementation: Experiment-local selected-slice reconstruction; no complete donor array is loaded.
baseline.donor_array_access: After the source-access lock, memory-map delta.npy and copy only permitted 81-target by response-gene slices. Bind genes.txt, perts.txt, meta.json, and the frozen source ledger; never hash delta.npy.
baseline.donor_gene_axis_duplicate_policy: Preserve the full donor gene-axis shape and resolve duplicate symbols to their last occurrence, matching production donor loading.
baseline.donor_centering_and_scale_statistics: Computed only from the permitted 81 target rows; the nine sealed-overlap rows are absent.
baseline.whitener: Historical-panel-safe low-rank signal-covariance operator fitted only from selected donor slices.
baseline.whitener_coordinate_mask: Exclude every one of the 81 evaluation-target coordinates and all 300 VCC target coordinates before fitting or transforming.

target_folds.algorithm: Sort the frozen 81 targets by lowercase-SHA256 then target symbol and assign round-robin to folds 0 through 4.

for_each_outer_batch_and_target_fold: Exclude every outcome from every context in the held experimental batch.
Exclude every occurrence of every held-fold target from fitting, outcome-dependent normalization, calibration, and candidate selection.
On the other four target folds, perform four-way whole-target cross-fitting: fit on three folds and predict the fourth across non-held contexts.

Concatenate the four inner prediction blocks before scoring any arm against the complete 64/65-target inner gallery. Candidate selection uses only non-held contexts with every inner target observed; contexts with authenticated missing pairs may contribute available training rows but never a shortened selection gallery.
Apply the single fixed intervention policy or exact identity fallback; do not tune a candidate grid.
Refit on all non-held-batch contexts and all four non-held target folds.
Predict the held target fold in every context of the held batch exactly once.
cross_fitting.complete_gallery_scoring: Inner selection scores concatenated 64/65-target cross-fitted predictions only in contexts where the entire nominal gallery is observed. Final scoring concatenates all five held-target folds and scores every observed query against that held context's complete available 79-81-target gallery.
cross_fitting.authenticated_missing_pair_policy: Seven source context-target pairs are absent. They remain available-row omissions in fitting; incomplete contexts are excluded only from inner candidate-selection scoring, never silently scored with a 62-65 target gallery.
cross_fitting.control_pca: Controls only; rank 8; fit on contexts outside the held experimental batch with equal total weight per remaining batch. It uses no perturbation outcomes.
cross_fitting.donor_features_for_held_targets: Allowed because the frozen production donors are available at inference.

estimator.label: At frozen source FDR <=0.05, 1 when nonzero finite incumbent and source truth signs disagree; 0 when they agree.
estimator.weight: abs(incumbent), normalized to equal total mass per context-target block, followed by inverse-class balancing.
matched_controls: matched zero-tail control using the full-HGB arm's exact selected mask and intervention budgets
weighted logistic regression on the full feature set
weighted logistic regression on donor-only features

intervention.eligibility: Score at or above the fixed within-block 0.995 quantile, nonzero incumbent, row-specific signed-credit mask, and at least two real production donors.
intervention.ranking: Descending wrong-sign probability with ascending coordinate index as deterministic tie break.
intervention.action: Flip sign exactly and preserve absolute magnitude.
intervention.selection: No hyperparameter search. The fixed full-feature HGB arm is enabled only if its complete-gallery inner cross-fit has positive macro signed-credit gain, nonnegative gain in every represented batch, PDS delta at least -0.002, and does not trail same-capacity donor-only HGB. Otherwise use exact identity.

source_metrics.pds: Raw cosine PDS with exact midranks, every observed cross-fitted query against its held context's complete available 79-81-target gallery after excluding all 81 permitted DepMap target coordinates and all 300 VCC target coordinates.
source_metrics.signed_credit: sum(sign(truth) * prediction) / sum(abs(prediction)) per target at the frozen source FDR threshold after excluding all 300 VCC coordinates and only that row's own permitted DepMap target coordinate.
source_metrics.flip_precision: abs(incumbent)-weighted fraction of flipped coordinates whose incumbent sign was wrong.

whole_target_refit_permutation.operation: Within every outer batch x target-fold cell, partition training targets by their exact availability pattern across non-held contexts, derange whole-target outcome blocks only within each identical pattern class, refit the fixed full-feature HGB one fit at a time, and evaluate the unchanged held block.

target_block_bootstrap.unit: one of five deterministic whole-target folds after each target is aggregated with the principal score's equal-batch estimand
